cues.en: Hello and welcome back.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎回來。

cues.en: Today, we're talking about XGBoost for classification.
cues.zh: 今天談分類用的 XGBoost。

cues.en: Alright, so this is what our sample dataset for regression looked like, and the very first model in the series of consecutive XGBoost models
cues.zh: 這是迴歸範例資料，以及構成 XGBoost 的一連串模型中，

cues.en: that comprise XGBoost.
cues.zh: 第一個模型。

cues.en: Our first model was a simple average, and that's what we used.
cues.zh: 第一個只是簡單平均值。

cues.en: And from there, we calculated the residuals and built on that.
cues.zh: 由此計算殘差，再繼續建立模型。

cues.en: In the case of classification, the dataset looks slightly different.
cues.zh: 分類的資料集稍有不同。

cues.en: Because it's classification, there's basically two classes: zero and one.
cues.zh: 因為是分類，基本上有兩類，0 與 1。

cues.en: They are represented by zero and one.
cues.zh: 用 0、1 表示。

cues.en: And we are answering a question: which class does an observation fall under?
cues.zh: 要回答：這筆觀測屬於哪類？

cues.en: So here, we don't take the average.
cues.zh: 這裡不取平均。

cues.en: Typically, what is done is a value of 0.5 is taken, like a probability score of 0.5.
cues.zh: 通常先用 0.5，也就是機率分數 0.5。

cues.en: So the first model in the series of models which comprise XGBoost will predict 0.5.
cues.zh: 所以 XGBoost 模型序列第一個模型，預測 0.5。

cues.en: And when we're talking about probabilities, just as a quick refresher, what that means is that if, let's say, if a point, like a new point in your dataset that you're predicting a value for,
cues.zh: 快速複習機率，假設要預測資料集中的新點，

cues.en: has a probability of 0.8, then that means it's closer to category one.
cues.zh: 機率為 0.8，就比較接近第 1 類。

cues.en: That means it'll eventually, when you present your final results, it'll be in category one.
cues.zh: 最後呈現結果時，歸到第 1 類。

cues.en: Or if it predicts, like, 0.13, a probability of 0.13, it's close to category zero.
cues.zh: 如果機率是 0.13，就接近第 0 類。

cues.en: So then it'll be assigned to category zero.
cues.zh: 會分到第 0 類。

cues.en: So as our first model, we are just predicting everything at 0.5.
cues.zh: 第一個模型先對所有點預測 0.5。

cues.en: And from there, we're going to calculate the residuals.
cues.zh: 由此計算殘差。

cues.en: So for these points, it's 0.5.
cues.zh: 這些點是 0.5。

cues.en: For these, it's negative 0.5.
And from there, we're gonna build models that will be built from the information we have about the residuals.
cues.zh: 再根據殘差資訊建立後續模型。

cues.en: Now, it's not gonna be as straightforward or as simple as regression.
cues.zh: 但沒有迴歸那麼直接、簡單。

cues.en: It's more complex.
cues.zh: 更複雜。

cues.en: I'll even say much more complex.
cues.zh: 甚至複雜很多。

cues.en: In this tutorial, we'll have a high-level overview of how it works with minimal math.
cues.zh: 這堂用最少數學，做高層次介紹。

cues.en: At the end of this course is another tutorial with advanced calculations.
cues.zh: 課程最後另有進階計算教學。

cues.en: And if you'd like to dive in deeper, you can check that out.
cues.zh: 想深入可以看。

cues.en: Alright, so for regression, we would build a chart with the residuals, and then we would find, using similarity scores,
cues.zh: 迴歸時，會畫殘差圖，再用相似度分數，

cues.en: we'd calculate the similarity score for everything.
cues.zh: 先算全部資料的相似度。

cues.en: Then we'd find the right split because we would calculate the similarity score for the left and for the right parts.
cues.zh: 接著算左右兩部分相似度，找正確分割。

cues.en: That's the formula that would be used for the similarity score.
cues.zh: 這是相似度公式。

cues.en: Then we would use the Gain calculation to find out if this is indeed the best split.
cues.zh: 再算 Gain，判斷是不是最佳切分。

cues.en: And that's how we would find the split.
cues.zh: 由此找分割。

cues.en: In the case of classification, it's slightly different.
cues.zh: 分類稍微不同。

cues.en: It's similar, but there are nuances.
cues.zh: 類似，但有細節差異。

cues.en: So again, we have a split.
cues.zh: 同樣先有分割。

cues.en: And then for this split, well, for the whole dataset,
cues.zh: 對這個分割，先對整份資料，

cues.en: we would calculate the similarity score.
cues.zh: 計算相似度。

cues.en: Then we would calculate it for the left leaf of the split, the right leaf of the split.
cues.zh: 再算左葉與右葉。

cues.en: And the difference here, or the nuance, is that the similarity score has a different formula.
cues.zh: 差別是相似度公式不同。

cues.en: It's got sum of residuals squared divided, as before, but then instead of the number of residuals, it's got the sum of the probability of each point
cues.zh: 同樣是殘差總和平方作分子，但分母不是殘差數量，而是各點機率

cues.en: times one minus the probability of that same point.
cues.zh: 乘以 1 減同一點機率，

cues.en: And then we sum them up.
cues.zh: 再全部相加。

cues.en: So as you can see, it gets more nuanced here because the similarity score is dependent on the previous probability.
cues.zh: 所以更細緻，因為相似度取決於之前的機率。

cues.en: So 0.5 being the previous probability for all points.
cues.zh: 一開始所有點的前一個機率都是 0.5。

cues.en: But as we go further into the woods, then we have more and more decision trees, the probabilities for these points will be different.
cues.zh: 但隨著樹越來越多，各點機率會不同。

cues.en: So every time, these probabilities, you need to calculate the similarity score for every single point.
cues.zh: 每次計算相似度，都需要各個點的這些機率。

cues.en: Yeah, and it might be different because of the probabilities for the points.
cues.zh: 因為各點之前機率不同，

cues.en: The previous probability was different.
cues.zh: 結果也會不同。

cues.en: So that's the similarity score.
cues.zh: 這就是相似度。

cues.en: And what that also means is that we cannot draw a chart.
cues.zh: 也表示不能只畫一張圖。

cues.en: We cannot just simply use a chart of the residuals.
cues.zh: 不能只使用殘差圖。

cues.en: As you can see here, in the case of regression, we're using a chart of residuals, and then we are working with that.
cues.zh: 迴歸時，使用殘差圖並據此處理。

cues.en: Whereas in classification, we cannot just simply do that.
cues.zh: 分類則不能單純這樣。

cues.en: We have to keep working with the original chart, and that's why the axis is on the bottom, because the probabilities will actually matter.
cues.zh: 必須繼續使用原始圖，因此座標軸在底部，因為機率本身有影響。

cues.en: Alright, so once we have the splits, right?
cues.zh: 有了切分後，

cues.en: So we have the split for the tree.
cues.zh: 就有樹的分割。

cues.en: In this case, there's two of them.
cues.zh: 這裡有兩個。

cues.en: That's what we calculated.
cues.zh: 就是剛算出的。

cues.en: In regression, we calculated the averages of all of the values in here.
cues.zh: 迴歸時，算這些值的平均。

cues.en: And that's basically what the leaf output was.
cues.zh: 那基本上就是葉節點輸出。

cues.en: For every tree, through these terminal leaves, the output was the simple average.
cues.zh: 每棵樹的終端葉，輸出是簡單平均。

cues.en: In the case of classification, it's quite different.
cues.zh: 分類則很不同。

cues.en: So here, we've got our splits for the different leaves of the tree, and now we've got these probabilities that are calculated using the following formula.
cues.zh: 有了各葉的分割，再用以下公式計算這些機率。

cues.en: So the leaf output, by the way, which is not the probability, we will get to this in a second, but the leaf output, something that we calculate before we get to these probabilities,
cues.zh: 順帶一提，葉節點輸出不是機率，稍後會說。它是在得到機率之前，先計算的值，

cues.en: the leaf output is calculated as the sum of residuals divided by the previous probability of the point.
cues.zh: 講者這裡說，殘差總和除以與該點先前機率有關的分母。

cues.en: So in our case, this would be 0.5 times 1 minus 0.5.
cues.zh: 這裡會是 0.5 乘以 1 減 0.5。

cues.en: But then again, as you build the next tree, you use the probability from the previous tree.
cues.zh: 但建立下一棵樹，就用前一棵樹的機率。

cues.en: So this is basically the first tree that we built.
cues.zh: 這基本上是第一棵樹。

cues.en: Then the second tree will be using these probability scores.
cues.zh: 第二棵會用這些機率分數。

cues.en: And as you can see, it'll become more and more complex.
cues.zh: 可以看到會越來越複雜。

cues.en: And that's another reason why we have to keep using, for visualization purposes, we have to keep using this chart.
cues.zh: 這也是視覺化時必須保留這張圖的另一原因。

cues.en: And we cannot just switch to the chart of residuals.
cues.zh: 不能直接切換成殘差圖。

cues.en: Now, what is this log odds?
cues.zh: 什麼是 log odds？

cues.en: Why are we calculating leaf output through log odds?
cues.zh: 為什麼透過對數勝算計算葉節點輸出？

cues.en: Well, let's dissect that a little bit in more detail.
cues.zh: 再稍微仔細拆解。

cues.en: Again, there'll be a more detailed tutorial at the end of the course.
cues.zh: 最後會有更詳細教學。

cues.en: But just for a high-level overview, let's have a look.
cues.zh: 這裡先做概觀。

cues.en: So log odds, this is our original chart for the classification problem.
cues.zh: 這是分類問題的原始圖，要進入對數勝算。

cues.en: Based on similarity score and Gain calculations, we've figured out that these are the splits, right?
cues.zh: 根據相似度與增益，已找出這些分割。

cues.en: So let's assume that those are the correct splits at 20 and at 40.
cues.zh: 假設正確分割在 20 與 40。

cues.en: So how do we build this decision tree?
cues.zh: 如何建立樹？

cues.en: Well, log odds, we have to dive into the world of log odds.
cues.zh: 需要進入對數勝算的世界。

cues.en: This is the world of probabilities, and here's gonna be the world of log odds.
cues.zh: 這是機率世界，這邊是對數勝算世界。

cues.en: So log odds, just as a quick refresher, is first you take odds, which is P divided by 1 minus P.
cues.zh: 快速複習，先算勝算，P 除以 1 - P。

cues.en: And in this case, it's odds is 0.5 divided by 1 minus 0.5.
And log odds is basically simply the natural logarithm of that value.
cues.zh: 對數勝算，就是該值的自然對數。

cues.en: And the reason why we dive into log odds is because when we are building these decision trees, remember we are gonna have a value here, then decision tree and decision tree, we're gonna be adding them up.
cues.zh: 為什麼用它？因為建立這些樹時，記得先有起始值，再加決策樹、決策樹，會相加。

cues.en: Well, we can't add probabilities up because we risk having a probability greater than one, which is just nonsensical.
cues.zh: 不能直接加機率，否則可能超過 1，沒有意義。

cues.en: It doesn't make sense.
cues.zh: 不合理。

cues.en: We can't just simply add up probabilities.
cues.zh: 不能直接累加機率。

cues.en: But what we can add up is log odds.
cues.zh: 但可以加對數勝算。

cues.en: We're not going to go into the math behind it and why it works that way.
cues.zh: 不深入背後數學與原因。

cues.en: We're just gonna take it as a given that this is how we can deal with probabilities.
cues.zh: 先接受這是處理機率的方式。

cues.en: Let's just see how we can take advantage of this.
cues.zh: 看看如何利用。

cues.en: So in this case, log odds is zero, and that's our starting point: 0.
cues.zh: 這裡對數勝算為 0，就是起點。

cues.en: But now, let's see, for the first residuals, how are we gonna build this tree?
cues.zh: 對第一組殘差，如何建樹？

cues.en: So the tree will have two branches, well, these two branches and these two branches.
cues.zh: 樹有這兩個分支，以及這兩個分支。

cues.en: So below 20, between 20 and 40, and above 40.
cues.zh: 也就是低於 20、20 到 40、超過 40。

cues.en: And the leaf output, as we discussed, is calculated by using this formula.
cues.zh: 如前所述，葉輸出用這個公式。

cues.en: Now, if you plug in the values of all of the inputs into this formula, then you'll get these following leaf outputs.
cues.zh: 代入全部輸入值，得到以下葉輸出。

cues.en: Again, we're not going to dive into the calculations now, but let's just take them as a given.
cues.zh: 現在不深入計算，先接受這些結果。

cues.en: And then from here, what you would do to get the probabilities, right?
cues.zh: 接著如何取得機率？

cues.en: So we have the log odds, we're building the trees in the world of log odds.
cues.zh: 有對數勝算，在對數勝算世界建樹。

cues.en: Now, to get to the probabilities, what you would do is reverse the calculation, basically reverse this calculation from probability to log odds.
cues.zh: 要回機率，就反轉機率到對數勝算的計算。

cues.en: You would reverse it, and it's done with this formula.
cues.zh: 用這個公式反轉。

cues.en: And once you apply this formula, you would get these probabilities.
cues.zh: 套用後，得到這些機率。

cues.en: And the way it works is you take these values, and by the way, you have to do it per observation.
cues.zh: 做法是取這些值，而且必須逐筆觀測計算。

cues.en: Right now, they're all the same in each leaf, but as you'll see, they can be different.
cues.zh: 目前每葉相同，但稍後會看到也可能不同。

cues.en: So here, those are the residuals.
cues.zh: 這裡是殘差。

cues.en: So we calculate the probabilities, then we'll calculate the residuals, which is quite straightforward, and then we'll use that in the next tree.
cues.zh: 先算機率，再算很直接的殘差，再用於下一棵樹。

cues.en: So again, based on a similarity score and Gain calculations, we'll get this next tree.
cues.zh: 同樣根據相似度與增益，得到下一棵樹。

cues.en: And let's say it splits the data like that.
cues.zh: 假設這樣分割。

cues.en: So we're going to build the tree in the world of log odds.
cues.zh: 在對數勝算世界建樹。

cues.en: We're going to calculate, using this formula, the leaf outputs, which is becoming more and more complex because we have to use prior probabilities.
cues.zh: 用公式算葉輸出，因為需要前一輪機率，所以越來越複雜。

cues.en: And then using the reverse formula, we're gonna go back into the world of probabilities, and we will get the following probabilities.
cues.zh: 再用反向公式回機率世界，得到以下機率。

cues.en: And what you will see here is an interesting observation that these four data points are all in one leaf, but they have different probabilities.
cues.zh: 有趣的是，這四個點在同一葉，機率卻不同。

cues.en: And that's because their prior probabilities were also different.
cues.zh: 因為先前機率也不同。

cues.en: And that's where these calculations, this leaf output, comes into play.
cues.zh: 這正是這些計算、葉節點輸出的作用。

cues.en: So that's something to keep in mind.
cues.zh: 需要記住。

cues.en: That's why we cannot just switch our charts to the world of residuals.
cues.zh: 所以不能只把圖換成殘差世界。

cues.en: We have to keep building this whole chart the whole way if we want to visualize what we're doing.
cues.zh: 想視覺化，就必須一直保留完整圖形。

cues.en: And the other thing to understand here is the way we go to whichever one of these back to the world of probabilities is we take the log odds and we add them up.
cues.zh: 另一點，回到任何這些點的機率世界時，要先把對數勝算加總。

cues.en: So we take 0, let's say we're looking at a point, let's say we're looking at this point, we'll take 0 plus, in this tree, this point will go down this path, and in this tree it'll go down this path.
cues.zh: 例如看這個點，先取 0，在這棵樹走這條路，在另一棵走這條路。

cues.en: So we add 0 plus 2 plus 1.51, that will be our log odds.
And then, based on the 3.51 will be our log odds.
cues.zh: 對數勝算為 3.51。

cues.en: And based on that log odds, that's when we go back to probabilities, and that's where we get 0.97 from.
cues.zh: 再根據對數勝算回到機率，得到 0.97。

cues.en: So that is it in a nutshell.
cues.zh: 簡單來說就是這樣。

cues.en: That's how XGBoost for classification works.
cues.zh: 這是分類用 XGBoost 的運作。

cues.en: As you can see, it's quite a bit more complex.
cues.zh: 可以看到複雜得多。

cues.en: But the main takeaway is we got a high-level overview that we have to work with log odds and probabilities.
cues.zh: 但主要概念是，需要使用對數勝算與機率。

cues.en: It works really well, as you'll see in the practical tutorials.
cues.zh: 實作會看到效果很好。

cues.en: And now you'll be able to leverage it there.
cues.zh: 現在就能在實作運用。

cues.en: And if you'd like a deeper dive into the math behind how this is calculated, check out the tutorial at the end of the course where we walk through that together.
cues.zh: 想深入計算的數學，可看課程最後教學，我們會一起算。

cues.en: On that note, I look forward to seeing you back here next time.
cues.zh: 期待下次見。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受機器學習的樂趣吧。
